name: @sumi-os/docs-workspace
description: Human and machine-readable Sumi documentation product workspace.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sumi-os/corpus-contract build && pnpm --filter @sumi-os/docs-mcp build && pnpm --filter @sumi-os/docs-web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sumi-os/corpus-contract test && pnpm --filter @sumi-os/docs-mcp test && pnpm --filter @sumi-os/docs-web test
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:repository-policy && pnpm lint && pnpm duplication && pnpm verify:lockfile && pnpm verify:contract && pnpm verify:mcp && pnpm verify:web
scripts.verify:integration: pnpm --filter @sumi-os/corpus-contract build && pnpm --filter @sumi-os/docs-mcp build && pnpm --filter @sumi-os/docs-web build && pnpm --filter @sumi-os/docs-web verify:mcp && pnpm verify:hosts
scripts.verify:repository-policy: node --test tests/repository-policy.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-host-files.mjs --tracked && node scripts/verify-workflows.mjs && pnpm verify:i18n
